text: Reset password: Click 'Forgot Password' on the sign-in page to receive a reset link via email.
Enable two-factor authentication: Go to Account Settings > Security and toggle on 2FA to add an extra layer of protection.
Update email address: Contact support to change your account email. Verification is required for security.
Add or update phone number: Navigate to Profile Settings and click 'Edit Phone' to update your contact number.
Edit profile information: Access your profile page to update name, bio, profile picture, and other personal details.
Manage privacy settings: Control who can see your activity and information in Settings > Privacy & Data.
Delete my account: Account deletion is permanent. Request deletion through Settings > Account > Delete Account.
View active login sessions: Check Settings > Security > Active Sessions to see where you're logged in and revoke access.
Join the loyalty rewards program: Earn points on every purchase. Enroll at Rewards > Sign Up to start earning.
Export account data and order history: Download all your data as CSV or JSON from Settings > Data Export.
Track order status: View real-time tracking on the Orders page using your order number.
Cancel an order: Orders can be cancelled before fulfillment. Go to Orders > View Details > Cancel.
Modify items in pending order: Edit quantities or remove items before fulfillment via Order Details page.
Place bulk or wholesale orders: Contact our wholesale team at wholesale@company.com for orders over 50 units.
View complete order history: Access all past orders with filters by date, status, and amount on the Orders page.
Set up recurring subscription orders: Select 'Subscribe & Save' at checkout for automatic deliveries at your chosen interval.
Add gift wrapping and custom message: Enable gift options at checkout and include a personalized note.
Include special delivery instructions: Add notes like gate codes or 'leave at door' in the shipping section at checkout.
Split order across multiple addresses: Not currently supported. Place separate orders for different shipping addresses.
Combine multiple orders into one shipment: Contact support within 1 hour of ordering to request order consolidation.
Standard domestic shipping timeline: Delivery takes 3-5 business days for addresses within the continental US.
International shipping availability: We ship to over 40 countries. Check country list at Shipping Info page.
Expedited and overnight shipping: Select Express (2-day) or Overnight options at checkout for faster delivery.
Change shipping address after ordering: Address changes are possible before fulfillment. Contact support immediately.
Track package with carrier: Click the tracking number in your order confirmation to see live carrier updates.
Supported shipping carriers: We use USPS, UPS, FedEx, and DHL based on destination and speed selected.
Ship to PO Box or APO/FPO addresses: PO Boxes accepted for USPS shipments. APO/FPO addresses supported for military.
Request delivery hold at carrier facility: Use carrier's website with your tracking number to redirect to pickup location.
Reroute package to new address: Contact carrier directly within 24 hours of shipment for address redirection.
International customs and duties: Recipient is responsible for customs fees. Commercial invoice included with all shipments.
Accepted payment methods: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, and Apple Pay.
Access and download invoices: Invoices are emailed after purchase and available in Orders > Order Details > Invoice.
Request refund to original payment: Refunds process to original payment method within 5-7 business days after approval.
Apply store credit to purchase: Store credit automatically appears at checkout. Toggle to apply or save for later.
Understanding sales tax charges: Tax calculated based on shipping address and local regulations at checkout.
Pay in different currency: Prices display in USD. International cards accepted with currency conversion by your bank.
Set up automatic subscription payments: Subscription billing uses saved payment method. Update in Subscriptions > Payment.
Dispute or report unauthorized charge: Contact support immediately with order number to investigate billing issues.
Save payment method for faster checkout: Add cards to your wallet at Checkout or in Settings > Payment Methods.
Apply discount or promo code: Enter code at checkout in the 'Promo Code' field before completing payment.
Return policy and eligibility: 30-day returns accepted for most items in original condition with tags attached.
Start a return request: Initiate returns from Orders > Return Items. Select reason and preferred refund method.
Print prepaid return shipping label: Return labels are emailed after approval and available in your Returns dashboard.
Return refund processing time: Refunds issue within 5-7 days after we receive and inspect the returned item.
Exchange item for different size or color: Select 'Exchange' when initiating return. New item ships after return received.
Restocking fee for returns: Most returns are free. 15% restocking fee applies to opened electronics and custom items.
Return damaged or defective product: Defective items eligible for full refund or replacement. Photos may be required.
Partial return from multi-item order: Yes, you can return individual items. Refund reflects returned items only.
International return shipping: International customers responsible for return shipping costs unless item is defective.
Return window and deadline: Returns must be initiated within 30 days of delivery date. Extensions not available.
Contact customer support: Reach us via live chat, email at support@company.com, or call 1-800-SUPPORT.
Support team hours of operation: Live support available Monday-Friday 9am-9pm EST. Email support 24/7.
Escalate issue to supervisor: Request escalation during chat or email. Supervisor will respond within 24 hours.
Submit product feedback or feature request: Share suggestions at feedback@company.com or through the in-app feedback form.
Check support ticket status: Track open tickets in Support Center using your ticket number or email confirmation.
